about: A report that says the fix is not landed is acted on in the same turn (tell the subagent to land it), not only passed on.

turns.text: [a12] Fix ready in commit 1a2b3c4d5e6 on branch a12-contrast: composer border now 3:1 in light mode. Not landed: unpushed, the lint step is red on it.

checks.rubric: Passes when the Chief tells a12 (or a new subagent) to fix the lint failure and land the commit, and tells the user in a line or two that it is not landed yet and is being finished. Fails when it only relays the report or asks the user what to do.
